\[
xyz = 3,
\]
\[
(x-y)(y-z)(z-x) = 4,
\]

(x+y)(y+z)(z+x) = 40.
\]

Let
\[
S=x+y+z,\qquad Q=xy+yz+zx.
\]
Then \(xyz=3\), and
\[
(x+y)(y+z)(z+x)=SQ-xyz=40
\]
so
\[
SQ=43. \tag{1}
\]

The numbers \(x,y,z\) are the roots of
\[
f(T)=T^3-ST^2+QT-3.
\]
Its discriminant is
\[
\Delta=S^2Q^2-4Q^3-12S^3-243+54SQ.
\]
Using \(SQ=43\) and \(\Delta=(x-y)^2(y-z)^2(z-x)^2=16\),
\[
16=1849-4Q^3-12S^3-243+2322,
\]
hence
\[
Q^3+3S^3=978. \tag{2}
\]
From (1), \(Q=43/S\). Put \(U=S^3\). Then
\[
\frac{43^3}{U}+3U=978,
\]
so
\[
3U^2-978U+79507=0.
\]
Thus
\[
U=163\pm \frac{10\sqrt6}{3},
\]
and therefore
\[
S=\sqrt[3]{163\pm \frac{10\sqrt6}{3}}.
\]

Let
\[
S_1=\sqrt[3]{163-\frac{10\sqrt6}{3}},\qquad
S_2=\sqrt[3]{163+\frac{10\sqrt6}{3}},
\]
so \(S_1<S_2\). For
\[
f_a(T)=T^3-aT^2+\frac{43}{a}T-3,
\]
we have \(f_a(0)=-3\) and \(f_a(1)=43/a-a-2\). Since \(a<28/5\) for both \(S_1,S_2\), \(f_a(1)>0\). Also, for \(T>0\),
\[
f_{S_2}(T)-f_{S_1}(T)
=-(S_2-S_1)\left(T^2+\frac{43T}{S_1S_2}\right)<0.
\]
Thus the smallest positive root of \(f_{S_1}\) is smaller than the smallest positive root of \(f_{S_2}\). So the minimum possible \(x\) is the smallest positive root of
\[
f(T)=T^3-S_1T^2+\frac{43}{S_1}T-3.
\]
This smallest root is attainable as \(x\) by ordering the three roots \(a<b<c\) and taking \((x,y,z)=(a,b,c)\), for which
\((x-y)(y-z)(z-x)=4\).

Now solve this cubic. Put \(T=v+S_1/3\). The depressed cubic is
\[
v^3+Av+B=0,
\]
where
\[
B=\frac{20(\sqrt6-3)}{81}.
\]
Because the original discriminant is \(16\), the Cardano discriminant is
\[
\left(\frac B2\right)^2+\left(\frac A3\right)^3=-\frac4{27}.
\]
Taking principal branches for the two non-real cube roots, the smallest root is

\[
\boxed{
\frac13\left(
\sqrt[3]{163-\frac{10\sqrt6}{3}}
-\sqrt[3]{\frac{10\sqrt6}{3}-10-6\sqrt{-3}}
-\sqrt[3]{\frac{10\sqrt6}{3}-10+6\sqrt{-3}}
\right)
}
\]
